title: Entity link
responsibility: Provides a real explorer link with in-app navigation for plain clicks.

inputs.name: EntityLink.nav
inputs.description: Required functions for constructing the link and navigating within the host.

inputs.name: EntityLink.label
inputs.description: Optional accessible name when visible content is insufficient. Defaults to JavaScript undefined (omitted), not the literal string.

outputs.name: EntityLink
outputs.description: Anchor with a real href. A plain click prevents document navigation and calls nav.go; modified/nonprimary clicks keep native behavior. Does not catch navigation errors. States: labelled: Short visible link content has a fuller accessible destination label. long: The complete long entity-link text wraps within the available width. focused: Keyboard focus visibly identifies the navigable entity link.

errors.name: Caller callback or content error
errors.description: Errors from supplied children callbacks or snippets propagate when invoked; this component does not provide an error boundary.
